author: consolidation card t_a3249982 (one DeepSeek worker)
purpose: Single versioned decision/evidence manifest for the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 serial CUDA port. Merges the upstream audit (t_79b60cb5), the 0731-vs-donor architecture contract (t_36cc607c), and the G0 test-first plan (g0-testfirst.md). Companion: deepseek-v4-t01-ownership-map-v1.md.

scope.target_hardware: one NVIDIA GB10 DGX Spark, 128 GB nominal unified memory, sharing the machine with loaded Hunyuan3D-2.1 shape pipeline and CUDA image moderation
scope.execution_mode: serial only, one request, no drafting for the first release; two-rank and DSpark out of scope
scope.development_rule: keep the live ds4 endpoint, Hunyuan, and moderation running; no full-model load without measured admission; no live backend stop/restart or client changes

D1_model_structure.decision: Adopt the donor shape reader as authoritative for the serial build; keep the TensorFold config dataclass in sync.
D1_model_structure.contract: Architecture integers must match exactly across reference, donor, and the 0731 GGUF (a mismatch is a hard validation failure).

fields.mtp: donor reads optional mtp.* head tensors; TensorFold 0731 serial reference does not use MTP

D2_tensor_layout.decision: Per-layer tensor names and quant types are fixed by the 0731 GGUF layout; the serial build must read exactly this set.

D3_kv_cache.decision: Adopt the donor slab geometry (raw_cache / comp_cache / index_comp_cache) as the serial cache contract.

precision.opt_in: FP8 packed compressed KV (DS4_CUDA_FP8_KV) and FP4 activation (DS4_CUDA_FP4_ACT) are OPT-IN ONLY; disabled for the first serial release
precision.tolerance_fp8: e4m3 max absolute error on packed values; top-1 logit margin must stay >= preregistered threshold
precision.tolerance_fp4: e2m1 max absolute error on activations; top-1 logit margin >= preregistered threshold

D4_attention.decision: Implement in CUDA per the donor kernel set: raw SWA read, compressor emit, indexer top-k read; keep the reference attention math (fp32 accumulation, exact masking) in the serial path.
D4_attention.algorithm: sliding-window 128 + per-layer ratio compressor + sparse indexer top-k over the compressed pool, with hash-layer routing (num_hash_layers=3)

D5_serial_execution_path.decision: Adopt the donor serial eager per-layer loop as the first release. Drafting (MTP / multi-token prediction) and cudaGraph capture are OUT OF SCOPE for R3.

gates.R3: serial only, one request, no drafting
gates.G11: window/compress/indexer equality tests required before enabling graph capture
